offer.text: The stores are nearly bare and bellies are growling. Bring sixteen loaves of bread and we'll see the village through the lean days.

accept.text: Thank you. Every loaf keeps a family fed.

decline.text: Then we ration what little we have and pray for a harvest.

in_progress.text: Any bread for the stores yet? Sixteen loaves.

ready.text: The granary's filling again. You've done us a great kindness.

complete.text: No one goes hungry tonight, thanks to you. The village won't forget it.

failed.text: The hunger set in before the bread came. A hard season, this.
